variety_description: A high-yielding, late-maturity, medium-tall, long slender grain variety is grown extensively in South India. Developed by MARUTERU, and released in 2008. Highly adapted to irrigated lowlands. Good cooking quality. Tolerant to important diseases and insect pests. Moderate HRR. Good grain weight.
